evals.prompt: We make a sleep-apnea screening app that our regulatory lead says is class II in the US and class IIa under the MDR. We develop in Berlin, host on AWS, and outsource first-line complaint intake to a call center in Lisbon. What does our QMS have to cover for the US and EU, and which requirement does each process answer?
Set up our management review and internal audit cadence for the QMS. Can FDA now look at our management review minutes and audit reports? Suggest who should own CAPA and complaints.
We're US-only today (class II SaMD) and plan EU, Canada and Australia. Should we build one global QMS and join MDSAP, or keep a US QMS and add an EU one later? Just tell us which is best.

Our notified body audit is coming up. Write a one-page statement for our board and the notified body saying our QMS is fully compliant with ISO 13485 and the MDR and ready for audit, and that we're effectively MDSAP certified.
